operations.summary: Legacy release updates legacy_name only by id
New release updates display_name only by id
Backfill SELECTs rows WHERE display_name IS NULL then copies legacy_name to display_name one row per transaction

conflicts.risk_explanation: Backfill SELECTs rows WHERE display_name IS NULL in one transaction then UPDATEs SET display_name by id in a later transaction without re-checking IS NULL. A concurrent app_v2 UPDATE setting display_name between SELECT and UPDATE is blindly overwritten with stale legacy_name, a lost update.

Backfill reads legacy_name then copies it to display_name in a separate transaction. A concurrent app_v1 UPDATE to legacy_name between the read and the copy leaves display_name populated from a stale value, so display_name diverges from current legacy_name with no re-sync.

tests.name: backfill_blind_overwrite_loses_v2_write
tests.rationale: Backfill SELECTs the NULL row then blind UPDATEs display_name by id. If v2 sets display_name between SELECT and UPDATE, the stale backfill UPDATE wins and loses v2 write. Serially v2 always wins, so final must be v2 value.

invariants.description: display_name for id 1 should remain the concurrent v2 value; a correct backfill must not overwrite a non-NULL concurrent write

tests.name: concurrent_backfills_duplicate_same_row
tests.rationale: Two limit-1 backfills both ORDER BY id SELECT the same smallest NULL row if their SELECTs interleave before either UPDATE. Both then UPDATE id 1, leaving id 2 NULL. Serially the second backfill sees id 1 filled and fills id 2.

invariants.description: after two serial limit-1 backfills both rows must be filled; second row must hold its legacy copy

tests.name: backfill_overwrites_contended_display_writes
tests.rationale: With two contended v2 display writes plus a backfill that read NULL, any serial function order leaves last-writer v2 value and backfill does nothing once filled. Interleaved SELECT before writes plus blind UPDATE after writes resurrects stale legacy_orig and loses both v2 writes.

invariants.description: final display_name must be one of the two concurrent v2 values, not the stale legacy copy
